title: kopsia stricta
intro: Kopsia stricta, commonly known as the Kopsia plant, is a species of plant in the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Kopsia stricta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive constituents also contribute to the plant's potential to modulate immune responses and exhibit cardiovascular-protective effects.
